images.title: Flowchart editor
images.caption: Named ports, orthogonal cable paths, groups and selection tools make construction direct. The inspector remains a centered dialog.

images.title: Station presentation
images.caption: The same station becomes a composed reading view: featured route, quiet alternate branch, story and setup photos.

images.title: Profile and personal albums
images.caption: Independent banner and avatar, personal albums and a chosen station showcase, with separate destinations for Photos, My shack and Gear for sale.

images.title: Enlarged photo viewer
images.caption: A daylight owner-view example with a large photograph, caption, thumbnails, explicit navigation and zoom. The viewer also serves authorized public albums.

images.title: Gear for sale
images.caption: A photo-led directory with search, categories, coarse regions, availability and seller contact. Demo listings; no checkout or protection claim.

images.title: Sell this gear
images.caption: Choose public photos, write condition and inclusions, set asking terms, then preview. Private inventory stays distinct from the published snapshot.

images.title: Gear photo manager
images.caption: Upload images or paste an image link to preview and import a managed copy. Choose a cover, order photos, write captions and deliberately select where to share.
